domains.summary: Adaptive selector, route registry, E2E layer routing, and import graph coverage.
mainRiskSignals: changed files map to no route
E2E manifest and generated test lists diverge
adaptive dry-run writes fixed .runtime report paths
domains.regressionExpectation: Route or selector changes must keep schema checks green and document any intentionally unmatched production file.

domains.summary: Playwright support, timing reports, failure-context capture, console allowlists, and timeout guardrails.
mainRiskSignals: console or timeout allowlists broadened without evidence
domains.regressionExpectation: Observability fixes must preserve structured timing and failure-context evidence and must not broaden allowlists to hide failures.

domains.summary: Static ownership and module boundary rules for renderer, runtime, startup, and support code.
mainRiskSignals: shared runtime state imports cross domains
domains.regressionExpectation: Boundary edits must preserve existing owner contracts or update the focused contract tests that describe the new boundary.

domains.summary: Binding-scoped global state writer authority, key ownership, alias coverage, and domain action migration.
mainRiskSignals: legacy writer gains an unregistered key or operation
state alias mutation escapes binding-scoped scanning
action module is created outside js/core/state/actions
P4 changed file lacks a direct state-ownership route
domains.regressionExpectation: State ownership changes must preserve exact writer, binding, key, operation, alias, and route contracts while reducing legacy authority phase by phase.

domains.summary: Map renderer lifecycle, render requests, render phases, canvas surfaces, pass catalogs, and diagnostics.
mainRiskSignals: renderer route selection leaves JS runtime files unmatched
domains.regressionExpectation: Renderer fixes must add or update focused Node/Python contracts before using Playwright as supporting evidence.

domains.summary: Scenario apply lifecycle, optional chunk promotion, scenario state, refresh plans, and scenario renderer bridge.
domains.regressionExpectation: Scenario runtime fixes must lock the failing transaction or state path with a focused regression contract.

domains.summary: Application startup, bootstrap handoff, hydration, recovery, and startup shell behavior.
mainRiskSignals: ready handoff not tied to real runtime state
domains.regressionExpectation: Startup changes must keep pure startup contracts green and reserve a main-thread lane for browser startup checks when behavior is visible.

domains.summary: Main app shell HTML, CSS, toolbar shell, sidebar shell, and shell-level i18n behavior.
mainRiskSignals: layout or i18n changes rely only on visual impression
shell files trigger main-thread browser ownership
domains.regressionExpectation: Main-shell fixes must include deterministic shell or toolbar coverage and use browser evidence only with explicit lane ownership.

domains.summary: UI shell controls, toolbar, sidebar, support panels, and shared frontend interaction wiring.
mainRiskSignals: interaction path depends on browser-only behavior
shared shell files overlap with main-thread UI work
accessibility references or dynamic labels drift
domains.regressionExpectation: UI shell bugs must add a focused Node, Python, or Playwright regression tied to the actual broken interaction.

domains.summary: City lights, city points, urban rendering, labels, reveal plans, and city asset contracts.
mainRiskSignals: city labels or reveal plan regress
domains.regressionExpectation: City changes must preserve asset and render owner contracts; visible city regressions need focused browser coverage.

domains.summary: Physical map layers, rivers, relief, texture overlays, and layer panel contracts.
mainRiskSignals: physical or river render owner changes
visual layer evidence lacks deterministic assertion
domains.regressionExpectation: Map-layer changes must preserve layer contracts and add focused coverage for any changed render owner or layer state behavior.

domains.summary: Generic water rendering, ocean rendering, river rendering, and water cache policy.
mainRiskSignals: hit target and final canvas diverge
named water or open ocean behavior needs browser evidence
domains.regressionExpectation: Water fixes must lock generic water or cache behavior with focused contracts; TNO-specific water data uses the tno-water domain.

domains.summary: TNO named water, open ocean, polar coverage, water geometries, chunk coverage, and related heavy geo validation.
domains.regressionExpectation: TNO water has no known child-safe coverage yet; agents must reserve main-thread or CI ownership and keep geometry reports as evidence.

domains.summary: TNO startup visibility, ready-state contracts, and context layer startup behavior.
domains.regressionExpectation: TNO startup changes should reuse generic startup contracts and reserve a browser lane for TNO-specific ready-state evidence.

domains.summary: Transport workbench manifests, country packs, facility rendering, line runtime, source contracts, and workbench UI.
mainRiskSignals: transport manifest report writes a fixed .runtime output path
country pack geometry or preview contract drift
browser lane needed for workbench UI behavior
domains.regressionExpectation: Transport changes must keep manifest contracts green with explicit .runtime output ownership and add focused runtime or workbench coverage for the changed facility or line behavior.

domains.summary: Project save, load, export, import, and persistence roundtrip behavior.
mainRiskSignals: browser lane required for save/load workflow
domains.regressionExpectation: Project IO fixes must add or update roundtrip coverage that proves the saved payload survives reload.

domains.summary: Strategic overlay state, runtime, rendering, editing, sidebars, and counter canvas behavior.
mainRiskSignals: overlay state and canvas render diverge
counter canvas smoke needs browser evidence
domains.regressionExpectation: Strategic overlay fixes must prove state and render behavior with a focused contract before browser smoke evidence.

domains.summary: Data catalog, runtime asset registry, thematic layer inputs, source ledgers, and governed scenario entries.
domains.regressionExpectation: Data changes must update the governing catalog or registry entry and keep data health or thematic contracts green.

domains.summary: Local backend routes, backend client behavior, cloud support diagnostics, and backend console helpers.
domains.regressionExpectation: Backend support changes must keep backend route/client contracts green and add focused coverage for private read or DTO behavior changes.

domains.summary: Pages dist generation, publish mirror, startup shell dist contract, and deploy artifact drift checks.
mainRiskSignals: startup shell or landing asset builder changes
domains.regressionExpectation: Pages dist has no child-safe owner because it writes generated outputs; reserve the dist lane and verify source/dist parity.

domains.summary: Public Pages release gate, propagation retry policy, and release-smoke helper contracts.
mainRiskSignals: release gate retries hide product assertion failures
Pages propagation failures need structured failure context
default deployed URL usage bypasses explicit candidate URL
domains.regressionExpectation: Release smoke changes must keep helper contracts child-safe and reserve the browser lane for deployed Pages validation.

domains.summary: Performance gates, benchmark runners, timing summaries, perf probes, and benchmark contracts.
mainRiskSignals: environment drift must be compared with baseline
domains.regressionExpectation: Perf changes must keep contract checks green and record benchmark artifacts when reserving the perf lane.

domains.summary: Runtime locales, i18n audit, baseline locale data, city aliases, geo aliases, and HGO place names.
mainRiskSignals: dynamic UI copy bypasses i18n audit
browser redraw needed for visible language switching
domains.regressionExpectation: I18n changes must keep audit coverage green and add visible-language coverage when dynamic UI redraw behavior changes.

domains.summary: Browser smoke inspection scripts, app-ready gates, and localhost-only inspection profile contracts.
mainRiskSignals: browser lane required for live inspection
app-ready gate no longer matches Playwright support
domains.regressionExpectation: Browser smoke changes must keep profile contracts green and reserve browser ownership for live localhost inspection.

domains.summary: Development workspace shell, split boundaries, selection ownership, and dev-only rendering checks.
domains.regressionExpectation: Dev-workspace changes must keep boundary contracts green and use E2E domain checks for visible workspace behavior.

domains.summary: Heavy geospatial contracts for topology, chunk assets, political gaps, and generated geographic artifacts.
mainRiskSignals: generated geometry artifacts may be rewritten
domains.regressionExpectation: Heavy geospatial changes must reserve the heavy-geo lane and preserve generated report evidence.

domains.summary: HOI4 scenario UI smoke, builder contracts, palette seed data, and scenario presentation.
mainRiskSignals: HOI4 seed or builder contract drift
scenario UI smoke needs browser ownership
domains.regressionExpectation: HOI4 scenario changes must keep builder contracts green and reserve browser ownership for UI smoke evidence.

domains.summary: Review regression Playwright workspace used for broad visible workflow regressions.
mainRiskSignals: review workspace route has no child-safe substitute
domains.regressionExpectation: Review-workspace changes must be treated as browser-owned regression evidence.

domains.summary: Scenario builders, startup bundle generation, checkpoint builders, and scenario build sessions.
domains.regressionExpectation: Scenario build changes must keep builder contracts green and reserve checkpoint/scenario-data ownership before writing outputs.

domains.summary: Strict scenario contracts, coverage ledgers, scenario reports, and scenario matrix checks.
domains.regressionExpectation: Scenario contract changes must keep strict reports as evidence and reserve scenario-data ownership when report paths are written.

domains.summary: Scenario shell overlay UI, scenario controls dispatch, and scenario shell boundary contracts.
domains.regressionExpectation: Scenario shell changes must keep boundary contracts green and use browser checks for visible overlay behavior.

domains.summary: App interaction funnel, map interaction event binding, shortcut surfaces, and user workflow flow.
mainRiskSignals: shortcut/history routes may be semantically related
domains.regressionExpectation: Interaction changes must lock event binding with Node coverage and use browser funnel evidence for user-visible flows.

domains.summary: Shortcut and history render-boundary browser behavior.
domains.regressionExpectation: Shortcut/history changes currently need browser-owned evidence or a new focused child-safe contract.

domains.summary: Sidebar shell, default collapse behavior, and sidebar split boundary contracts.
mainRiskSignals: sidebar collapse behavior needs browser evidence
domains.regressionExpectation: Sidebar changes must keep split boundary coverage green and reserve a browser lane for visible collapse behavior.

domains.summary: Texture overlay rendering and visual regression path.
domains.regressionExpectation: Texture changes must preserve owner behavior and use browser evidence for visible overlay regressions.

domains.summary: TNO strict coverage chain, Atlantropa coverage, polar coverage, ledgers, and chunk consistency.
domains.regressionExpectation: TNO coverage-chain changes must keep chunk contracts green and reserve scenario-data/heavy-geo ownership for coverage reports.

domains.summary: TNO scenario smoke behavior, runtime matrix, and TNO-specific UI entry points.
mainRiskSignals: TNO UI smoke requires browser ownership
domains.regressionExpectation: TNO scenario changes must keep generic scenario contracts green and reserve browser ownership for TNO smoke evidence.

domains.summary: UI contract foundation, base shell controls, and foundational accessibility/structure smoke.
mainRiskSignals: browser smoke needed for visible control behavior
domains.regressionExpectation: UI foundation changes must keep foundation contracts green and use browser evidence for visible shell behavior.

domains.summary: UI rework mainline/support transport hardening E2E routes and related contract plans.
mainRiskSignals: UI rework browser routes require ownership
domains.regressionExpectation: UI rework changes must keep plan contracts green and reserve a browser lane for the matching rework E2E route.

domains.summary: Palette runtime bridge, palette manager i18n, and palette-backed startup color behavior.
mainRiskSignals: selector has palette path heuristics with limited dedicated routes
domains.regressionExpectation: Palette changes must keep bridge/import contracts green and document selector route gaps when dedicated palette routes are absent.

domains.summary: Public sample project deep links, Guide sample card behavior, and checked-in sample release contracts.
mainRiskSignals: sample Guide browser flow requires browser ownership
canonical landing map generator or checked-in SVG/JSON parity drift
domains.regressionExpectation: Public sample changes must keep sample contracts, landing showcase tests, and canonical landing map asset parity green, then reserve a browser lane for visible Guide deeplink behavior.

domains.summary: Independent HGO pixel editor, native dataset and project handoff boundary.
mainRiskSignals: native pixels or editable water states change during source interpretation
main and native runtime dependencies cross their boundary
native project handoff or document revision validation drifts
domains.regressionExpectation: Run native dataset, engine and handoff contracts for HGO changes; use the native WebGL browser flow when interaction or rendering changes. Common-base scenario checks remain owned by their own domains.
